systems.system: Direct, real-time and remote electronic access by the Director-General of the Mauritius Revenue Authority to the Civil Status Database and the Central Population Database (new section 123J, Income Tax Act)

note: The Act (assented 2026-08-12) obliges the Registrar of Civil Status to give the revenue authority electronic access to the two databases; it names them without saying how or where a birth or death is recorded, so no fact of class civil.
